mapper.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT rsr.CHECK_IN_DATE AS check_in_date, rsr.CHECK_OUT_DATE AS check_out_date, rsr.RSR_ID AS rsr_id, rsr.RSR_NAME AS rsr_name, rsr.room_id AS room_id, rsr.RSR_DATE AS rsr_date, rev.REVIEW_ID AS review_id, r.PRICE AS price, r.DISCOUNT_PRICE AS discount_price, r.room_name room_name, a.MAIN_IMG AS acm_main_img, a.ACM_NAME AS acm_name, A.ACM_ID AS acm_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rsr.check_out_date, rsr.rsr_id) AS rnum FROM RESERVATION rsr JOIN ROOM r ON rsr.ROOM_ID = r.ROOM_ID JOIN ACCOMMODATION a ON r.ACM_ID = a.ACM_ID LEFT JOIN REVIEW rev ON rsr.RSR_ID = rev.RSR_ID
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(RSR_ID) cnt FROM RESERVATION WHERE USER_ID=#{USER_ID} and rsr_status='이용완료'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEW(CONTENT, ACM_ID, RATING, RSR_ID, USER_ID, REVIEW_ID) VALUES(#{content}, #{acm_id}, #{rating}, #{rsr_id}, #{user_id}, #{review_id})
